rules.summaryEn: Face a shared gauntlet of studio guests in Rock-Paper-Scissors to build the longest unbroken winning streak. Lobby guests, read tells, and manage your streak risk.
rules.summaryZh: 依次与观战嘉宾队列进行猜拳，争夺最长连胜纪录。在有限情报与游说机制下博弈，连胜中断仍须打完全程。
rules.setup: A shared ordered queue of 9 Studio Guests is revealed (with visible traits & prior tendency hints). Both candidates start with 0 current streak, 0 max streak, and 3 Lobby/Intel tokens.
rules.components: 9 Guest Portraits in ordered gauntlet; 3 RPS Cards (Rock, Paper, Scissors) per player; 3 Intel/Lobby tokens per player; dual Streak Trackers.
turnStructure: Pre-Match Lobby Phase (3 actions): Each candidate secretly assigns their 3 Lobby tokens to guests (e.g., 'Request Throw Reveal' or 'Sway Loyalty'). Guests react based on archetype and both players' bids.

Gauntlet Rounds 1–9: For each guest in order, both candidates independently lock their Rock/Paper/Scissors play against that guest's locked throw (each guest throws one fixed hand for Player A and one for Player B—or in S1 TV faithful mode, each guest picks a response per candidate influenced by pre-match diplomacy).
Resolution: Win = current streak +1 (updates max streak if higher). Draw or Loss = current streak resets to 0. Both players MUST complete all 9 matches even if their streak breaks.
Bonus Tension: After round 5, a mid-gauntlet 'Re-Order / Scout' check reveals the opponent's current max streak so trailing players can take calculated risks.
rules.hiddenVsPublicInfo: Public: Guest order, guest archetypes, completed match results, both players' current & best streaks. Hidden: Lobby token targets, private guest intel tells, and locked RPS choice before reveal.
rules.scoringAndPenalties: Score = Longest consecutive WIN streak achieved across the 9-guest gauntlet (Draws break streaks just like Losses).
rules.winConditions: Higher longest consecutive winning streak after all 9 guests are played.
rules.tieBreakers: 1) Total wins across all 9 matches; 2) Fewest losses (more draws); 3) Sudden-death RPS overtime against a neutral Dealer Bot until one player wins a round while the other does not.
rules.seasonVariants: S1E1: random guest order. S1E2: safe players chose shared order. S1E5: 4 eliminated guests returned in fixed order. Default web mode uses 9 guests with visible traits + 3 Lobby tokens.

aiStrategy.easy: Distributes Lobby tokens randomly and plays mostly uniform RPS with mild reaction to guest hints.
aiStrategy.genius: Clusters Lobby tokens on consecutive middle guests (positions 3–6) to maximize expected longest contiguous streak rather than total wins, using Bayesian inference on guest archetypes.
aiStrategy.grandFinal: Computes exact dynamic-programming streak expectation, aggressively contests overlapping high-value streak clusters when trailing, and adapts counter-throws to guest loyalty shifts.

rules.summaryEn: Zero-luck strategic Korean Yutnori: all 4 players secretly pick one of two Yut sticks (Flat vs Round) simultaneously—meaning you control half the throw and must outread your rival's half!
rules.summaryZh: 零运气的心理博弈掷柶：每方由主将与搭档组成，4人同时秘密决定投出平面或弧面柶木，4根合成步数（猪必为倒退猪！），先让主将2枚棋子绕完29格棋盘冲线者胜。
rules.setup: Standard 29-node Korean Yutnori board (20 outer perimeter stations + 9 interior diagonal shortcut stations including center). Each side has 2 Candidate Mals (gold-rimmed) and 2 Partner Mals (silver-rimmed) starting off-board at Start (node 0).
rules.components: 29-node traditional Yutnori board; 4 sticks total (each of the 4 characters holds 1 Flat/Marked stick [F] and 1 Round/Blank stick [R]); 8 Mals (4 per side: 2 Candidate, 2 Partner).
turnStructure: Active Team Turn: The active team (Candidate + Partner) and the defending team (Opponent + Partner) BOTH simultaneously and secretly select 2 sticks (0, 1, or 2 Flat sticks each; equivalently total Flat count F_team ∈ {0, 1, 2}).

Stick Reveal & Result (Total Flat sticks F = F_active + F_defending ∈ {0..4}):
  • F = 1 (3 Round, 1 Flat) → Back-Do (뒷도 / 빽도): move -1 step! (In Tactical Yutnori, ALL Do throws are Back-Do!)
  • F = 2 (2 Round, 2 Flat) → Gae (개): move +2 steps.
  • F = 3 (1 Round, 3 Flat) → Geol (걸): move +3 steps.
  • F = 4 (0 Round, 4 Flat) → Yut (윷): move +4 steps + BONUS THROW.
  • F = 0 (4 Round, 0 Flat) → Mo (모): move +5 steps + BONUS THROW.

Bonus Throw Rule: Rolling Yut (4) or Mo (5) OR capturing an enemy Mal grants an extra throw—HOWEVER, per official S4 rule, capturing an enemy Mal WITH Yut or Mo grants only 1 bonus throw (does NOT stack to 2). You accumulate throw results and apply them in any order.

Movement & Shortcuts: Landing EXACTLY on corner node 5 (top-right) lets you enter the diagonal toward Center (node 22 → node 15 → Start). Landing EXACTLY on corner node 10 (top-left) lets you cut diagonally through Center directly toward Start (node 0). Landing on Center (node 22) lets you take the shortest diagonal directly to Start.

Back-Do Special Rule: If a Mal is at node 1 (1 step past Start) and moves Back-Do (-1) onto Start (node 0), it counts as having completed a full lap! Moving +1 more or exiting scores it (on the show, stepping back onto Start completes the lap and the next move/exit finishes it—specifically in S1/S4 Korean rules: entering node 1 then Back-Do onto Start immediately places it on the home goal ready to finish, or counts as completing a lap so one more step exits; if no Mal is on board when Back-Do is rolled, the turn is wasted).

Stacking (Up-gi / 업기) & Capturing (Jap-gi / 잡기): Landing on your own Mal (Candidate or Partner) stacks them to move together as one unit (if captured, ALL stacked Mals return to off-board!). Landing on an enemy Mal sends it back off-board and grants 1 bonus throw.
rules.hiddenVsPublicInfo: Public: Entire 29-node board, all Mal positions/stacks, turn order, and past stick choices. Hidden: Each team's 2-stick choice (0, 1, or 2 Flats) until both lock in.
rules.scoringAndPenalties: A Mal finishes when it steps PAST Start (node 0) after traversing the board. Partner Mals finishing do NOT win the game—only Candidate Mals count (Partner Mals act as blockers, stack-carriers, and capture hunters).
rules.winConditions: First side to get BOTH of its Candidate Mals past the finish line wins immediately.
rules.tieBreakers: No ties possible; game always ends when one Candidate completes both Mals.
rules.seasonVariants: Exact same core rules in S1E3, S1E4, S1E10, and S4E2 (in S1, winning partner also won 1 Garnet from losing partner).

aiStrategy.easy: Picks stick parity heuristically toward 2–3 steps and moves its leading Candidate Mal greedily.
aiStrategy.genius: Computes a 3×3 payoff matrix over (Active picks 0/1/2 Flats) × (Defender picks 0/1/2 Flats) evaluating capture threats, corner-shortcut landings (nodes 5, 10, 22), Back-Do 1-node shortcut setups, and Mal stacking risk, then solves for an approximate mixed Nash equilibrium.
aiStrategy.grandFinal: Uses full minimax mixed-strategy Nash solver on the 3×3 stick game (never predictable!), intentionally plants a Candidate Mal on node 1 to threaten the famous 1→Back-Do finish, and uses Partner Mals as expendable capture shields.

rules.summaryEn: The signature Genius bluffing battle: you see your opponent's card (1–10) on their forehead, but NOT your own. Bet, raise, or fold—but folding a 10 costs a brutal 10-chip penalty!
rules.summaryZh: 《The Genius》最具代表性的心理博弈：双方将1–10数字牌贴于额头，只能看到对手的牌而看不到自己的牌。加注、跟注或弃牌——若拿10弃牌将额外罚给对手10枚筹码！
rules.setup: 20-card deck containing two sets of numbers 1 through 10. Both players start with 30 chips (S4 equal standard; optional S1 Garnet buy-in 1:5). First dealer/first-to-act is decided randomly, then winner of previous hand acts first (or alternates on tie).
rules.components: 20 cards (1–10 × 2); 30 Garnet Chips per player; Pot tray; Card-Count / Deck-Remaining counter (20→0, reshuffled when exhausted).
turnStructure: Ante & Deal: Both players post 1 chip ante into the pot (if a player has 0 chips they have already lost). Each player is dealt 1 card from the 20-card deck—face-up to the OPPONENT, hidden from SELF.

Betting Loop: Starting with the active player, players alternate choosing:
  • Check / Call: Match the opponent's current bet (first actor may Check at 0 extra chips above the 1-chip ante, letting the opponent Bet or Check to showdown; once a Raise is made, responder must Call, Re-Raise, or Fold).
  • Bet / Raise: Add chips to exceed opponent's current street commitment (up to max effective stack = min(myChips, oppChips)).
  • Fold: Surrender the pot immediately.
10-Card Fold Penalty: If a player FOLDS while holding a 10 on their own forehead, they MUST pay an extra 10 chips directly to the opponent (capped at remaining chips).
Showdown: When a bet is called (or both check), both cards are revealed. Higher number wins the entire pot.
Draw Carryover: If both cards have the SAME number, it is a tie—the entire pot remains on the table and carries over into the next hand (both players still post a 1-chip ante next hand!).
Deck Exhaustion: Cards are NOT returned to the deck between hands; when all 20 cards (10 hands) are dealt, a fresh 20-card deck is shuffled.
rules.hiddenVsPublicInfo: Public: Opponent's current card (to you!), pot size, both chip stacks, current bets, and all previously revealed cards in the current 20-card deck (enabling card counting!). Hidden: Your OWN card on your forehead until showdown or fold reveal.
rules.scoringAndPenalties: Winner takes pot. Folding with a 10 = -10 chip penalty paid to opponent. All-in side-pots capped to effective stack.
rules.winConditions: Reduce opponent's chip stack to 0.
rules.tieBreakers: If a simultaneous bust occurs on carryover/ante edge case, player with more chips before final hand wins (in standard betting, effective stack cap prevents simultaneous bust).
rules.seasonVariants: S1E6/E7: 1 Garnet = 5 chips. S1E9: Judge variant (anonymous spectator hints). S1E12 Final: 20 chips + items (+5 Chips, +2 to Card). S4E5: 30 chips each (recommended default).

aiStrategy.easy: Plays straightforwardly: bets big when seeing opponent's 1–4, folds often against 7–10, rarely bluffs.
aiStrategy.genius: Tracks exact remaining cards in the 20-card deck to calculate true win/tie/loss probability AND exact P(own card == 10) to avoid the -10 fold penalty; balances value bets with polarized bluffs when seeing opponent's 6–8.
aiStrategy.grandFinal: Solves GTO-inspired mixed betting/bluffing frequencies conditioned on exact remaining deck distribution, opponent's raise sizing, and carryover pot odds; deliberately traps with small bets when opponent holds 8–9 and remaining 10s are live.

rules.summaryEn: A deadly Dixit-style psychological mind game: give a clue for your surreal art card that fools your rival—but if ALL 5 guessers miss OR all 5 get it right, YOU lose 2 Garnets!
rules.summaryZh: 致命版《只言片语》：两位淘汰候选人轮流出题，为自己的抽象画卡给出提示词，其余5人各混入1张干扰卡后投票。对手猜中则出题者失1石榴石，对手猜错则对手失1石榴石；但若全场全中或全错，出题者重罚2石榴石！
rules.setup: Each candidate starts with 5 Garnets (TV show used players' current Garnets, balanced to 5 each for fair 1v1). All 6 seats (2 Candidates + 4 AI Panelists) are dealt a hand of 6 unique illustrated cards from a 48-card deck.
rules.components: 48 bespoke illustrated surreal SVG art cards (each with multi-dimensional theme/mood/symbol tags); 5 Garnet Life Gems per candidate; numbered voting tokens 1–6.
turnStructure: Clue Phase: Candidates alternate as the Tester. The Tester selects 1 card from their 6-card hand face-down and announces a brief clue (chosen from semantic clue bank in Solo AI mode, or custom/bank clue in Online P2P).
Decoy Phase: The Rival Candidate and all 4 AI Panelists each secretly submit 1 card from their own hand that best fits the Tester's clue.

Reveal & Vote Phase: All 6 submitted cards are shuffled and displayed face-up labeled #1–#6. Everyone EXCEPT the Tester (the Rival + 4 AI Panelists) secretly votes on which card belongs to the Tester (cannot vote for their own card).

Garnet Resolution:
  • Extremes Override (All 5 correct OR All 5 wrong): Tester loses 2 Garnets! (Clue was too obvious or too obscure.)
  • Otherwise, if Rival guessed Tester's card correctly: Tester loses 1 Garnet.
  • Otherwise, if Rival guessed WRONG (while at least 1 AI Panelist guessed right): Rival loses 1 Garnet!
Refill: All 6 players draw 1 replacement card (discard reshuffled if deck empties) and the Tester role switches.
rules.hiddenVsPublicInfo: Public: The Tester's clue, the 6 shuffled face-up candidate cards during voting, and post-vote card owners + votes. Hidden: Players' 6-card hands and secret votes until reveal.
rules.scoringAndPenalties: Zero-sum survival via Garnet depletion: -1 Garnet on standard loss, -2 Garnets on Tester total-sweep/total-whiff.
rules.winConditions: First candidate to reduce their rival to 0 Garnets wins.
rules.tieBreakers: Not possible (only one player loses Garnets per round).
rules.seasonVariants: Played exclusively in S1E8. Equalized 5-Garnet start recommended for balanced arcade matches.

aiStrategy.easy: Picks obvious single-tag clues (risking all-5-correct penalties) and votes for the highest literal tag match.
aiStrategy.genius: Calibrates clue specificity to target 2–3 out of 5 correct votes (Goldilocks zone), selects strong decoy cards matching the clue's secondary motif, and excludes its own card + tracks rival's clue style when voting.
aiStrategy.grandFinal: Models the exact semantic similarity distribution of the 4 AI Panelists to deliberately bait the human rival into a decoy while guaranteeing 1–2 panelists find the true card.

rules.summaryEn: Race to the front of a 20-tile conveyor belt by locating matching icons behind a shared 4×4 (A–P) flip wall. Hit a match to advance AND keep going; miss and your belt slides backward toward the abyss!
rules.summaryZh: 面对共享的16块字母翻转板（A–P），在自己的20格传送带上寻找眼前图案的对应位置。猜中前进1格并获得连翻机会；猜错则传送带倒退1格并换人。先冲到终点者胜，跌落传送带者立即淘汰！
rules.setup: A shared 4×4 board displays letters A–P, hiding 16 distinct high-contrast iconic pictures (shuffled secretly at start—no initial preview!). Each player has a 20-slot personal conveyor belt populated from a shuffled pool of 3×16 = 48 picture cards (ensuring the 20th Finish slot is fixed). Both players start on Slot 10 (S4 fair rule: 10 steps to reach Finish Slot 20, 10 misses to fall off behind Slot 1; optional S1/S2 Handicap mode: higher-garnet player starts on Slot 10, lower on Slot 8).
rules.components: Shared 4×4 flip board (A–P hiding 16 distinct SVG emblems); Dual 20-slot animated conveyor belts with runner tokens; Turn indicator.
turnStructure: Target Inspection: The active player looks at the picture card on the NEXT slot immediately ahead of their runner token on their personal conveyor belt.
Panel Flip: The active player selects one letter panel (A–P) on the shared 4×4 board. The panel flips open publicly for BOTH players to see (2.5 seconds) before flipping back closed.

Match (Correct): The player's runner advances +1 slot forward! If they reach Slot 20 (Finish Line), they WIN immediately. Otherwise, they retain their turn and MUST immediately attempt to match the next picture ahead (unlimited combo chain!).

Miss (Wrong): The player's conveyor belt shifts BACKWARD by 1 slot (moving the runner 1 step closer to the rear edge; a fresh card enters the front slot while the Finish card stays fixed, or runner steps back 1 slot toward 0). If the runner falls off behind Slot 1 (position 0), that player LOSES immediately! Otherwise, the turn passes to the opponent.
rules.hiddenVsPublicInfo: Public: Both conveyor belts' upcoming picture cards, runner positions, and every flipped panel while briefly open. Hidden: Unrevealed panels on the A–P board (both players share the same discovery history!).
rules.scoringAndPenalties: Correct = +1 slot + bonus turn. Incorrect = -1 slot (belt slides back) + turn ends.
rules.winConditions: 1) First player to reach Slot 20 (Finish Line), OR 2) Opponent falls off the back of their conveyor belt (position ≤ 0).
rules.tieBreakers: No ties possible.
rules.seasonVariants: S1E11 & S2E8: Higher-Garnet player started at 10, lower at 8. S4E7: Equal starting position (both start at 10/12; default 10 out of 20 gives crisp 10-step race & 10-miss cliff).

aiStrategy.easy: Remembers only the last 4–5 revealed panels (probabilistic forgetting) and picks randomly among unknown tiles.
aiStrategy.genius: Maintains strong memory (remembers ~85–90% of revealed panels), prioritizes probing unrevealed tiles when target is unknown so it maximizes information gain without revealing free answers for the opponent's immediate next card.
aiStrategy.grandFinal: Near-perfect 16-tile memory (with realistic tiny decay on early turns only), tracks the opponent's next belt tile so when forced to guess blind it avoids flipping tiles that aren't needed, and chains massive 5+ tile winning runs once ~11 tiles are mapped.

rules.summaryEn: Build the highest-sum 'Quattro'—4 cards of 4 different colors AND 4 different numbers—by revealing cards one by one and executing mandatory 1-for-1 trades with 6 deterministic Virtual Players.
rules.summaryZh: 凑齐4张颜色与数字均不相同的“Quattro”且总和更大者胜！采用第4季官方6名虚拟玩家规则（红蓝绿黄1–6共24张+2张黑0牌），在逐步翻开手牌的过程中与6位虚拟玩家各交换1次，精准算牌与规避0牌陷阱。
rules.setup: 26-card deck: Red, Blue, Yellow, Green numbered 1–6 (24 cards) + 2 Black Zero (0) cards. Both candidates are dealt 4 cards. Each candidate may independently call up to 2 Mulligans (returning their 4 cards and drawing 4 fresh ones). Remaining 18 cards are dealt 3 each to 6 Virtual Players (VP1–VP6).
rules.components: 26 color-coded Quattro cards (4 colors × 1–6 + two 0 cards); 6 Virtual Player vaults (3 hidden cards each); 4-slot candidate card trays (Revealed vs Hidden slots).
turnStructure: Opening Reveal: Both candidates choose 1 of their 4 cards to flip face-up permanently. (Face-up cards can NEVER be traded.)
Trading Rounds: Starting with First Player, candidates alternate choosing to either TRADE with an unused Virtual Player (VP1–VP6) OR PASS for this reveal phase.

How a Trade Works: Pick one of your HIDDEN cards and one Virtual Player you have NOT traded with yet. Your outgoing card is placed FACE-UP (publicly visible!) into that VP's hand, and the VP hands you 1 card FACE-DOWN (private to you!) following these exact deterministic S4 priority rules:
  1. If the VP holds a Zero (0) card, it ALWAYS gives you the Zero (0) card!
  2. Otherwise, considering your ALREADY FACE-UP cards, it gives you the highest-value card that can help complete a legal Quattro (distinct color & distinct number from your revealed cards).
  3. If none of its cards can help form a Quattro, it gives you its highest-numbered card.
  4. Tie-breaker for equal numbers: Red > Blue > Yellow > Green.

Next Reveal: When BOTH players consecutively pass (or have no legal trades left for now), both candidates must flip 1 more hidden card face-up. Repeat trading & revealing until all 4 cards are face-up.
Mandatory Quota: Before flipping their 4th (final) card face-up, BOTH candidates MUST have traded once with ALL 6 Virtual Players (6 total trades each).
rules.hiddenVsPublicInfo: Public: Both candidates' face-up cards, every card handed TO a Virtual Player (so you can deduce what's sitting inside VP1–VP6!), and which VPs each player has already used. Hidden: Unrevealed cards in candidates' hands and cards received FROM VPs until revealed.
rules.scoringAndPenalties: A legal Quattro = 4 cards with 4 distinct colors AND 4 distinct numbers. (In S4 rules, a Black 0 card counts as a 5th distinct color & distinct number 0, so it CAN complete a legal Quattro, though it adds 0 to sum! Optional S2 Classic Toggle: holding 0 is an automatic instant loss.)
rules.winConditions:
1) Completing a legal Quattro beats failing to complete a Quattro.
2) If BOTH complete a Quattro: higher sum of the 4 cards wins.
3) If NEITHER completes a Quattro: higher sum of the 4 cards wins.
rules.tieBreakers: Higher single highest card (e.g. 6+4+3+1 beats 5+4+3+2); if identical number multiset, sudden-death rematch.
rules.seasonVariants: S2E1: 41 cards (1–10 × 4 + one 0), 11 live onlookers, holding 0 = instant loss. S4E9: 26 cards (1–6 × 4 + two 0s), 2 mulligans, 6 deterministic Virtual Players, 0 valid in Quattro (recommended default for 1v1 web play).

aiStrategy.easy: Reveals high cards early and trades with VPs in sequential order without tracking opponent's discards.
aiStrategy.genius: Tracks exact cards deposited into VP1–VP6 by the opponent, intentionally visits a VP right after the opponent deposits a high card it needs, and times its own reveals to manipulate VP priority rule #2.
aiStrategy.grandFinal: Performs full probability inference over the 26-card deck to pinpoint which VPs hold the two 0-cards (avoiding them until opponent triggers them, or dumping a 0-card right before opponent visits!), optimizes mulligan thresholds (EV < 15.5), and sequences reveals to lock high-sum 6-5-4-3 Quattros.

rules.summaryEn: 10 sealed cups hide Sun, Moon, or Star. The first bettor chooses a symbol and wager (up to half the rival's chips); the second bettor is FORCED to wager AT LEAST DOUBLE that amount on a symbol!
rules.summaryZh: 10个神秘杯子各藏有日、月、星之一。双方初始各4枚筹码：先手下注额不得超过对手筹码的一半，后手则必须下注至少先手2倍的筹码！猜中获得3倍返还（净赚2倍），猜错全失，10轮后筹码多者胜或破产即淘汰。
rules.setup: 10 numbered Cups (Rounds 1–10), each secretly containing 1 symbol: Sun (☀), Moon (☾), or Star (★). Both candidates start with 4 chips. First-bettor role alternates every round (Round 1 determined by coin flip).
rules.components: 10 gilded celestial cups; 3 symbol tokens (Sun, Moon, Star); betting chip stacks (starting at 4 each); Guest Whisper clue card per cup.
turnStructure: Whisper / Intel Phase: Before betting on Cup #k, the cup's Guest sends a private clue to each candidate (e.g. eliminates 1 wrong symbol or claims a symbol with displayed Trust Rating: Reliable / Trickster / Neutral—ensuring skill & deduction rather than blind luck!).

First Bettor's Wager: The First Bettor selects a symbol (Sun, Moon, or Star) and bets B₁ chips where:
  • Minimum bet: 1 chip.
  • Maximum bet: floor(Opponent's chips / 2) — AND ≤ own chips. (Special edge case: if Opponent has only 1 chip, First Bettor bets 1 and Opponent goes All-In with 1.)

Second Bettor's Forced 2× Wager: Seeing the First Bettor's symbol AND bet B₁, the Second Bettor chooses ANY symbol (may pick the same or different!) and MUST bet B₂ chips where:
  • Minimum bet: min(Opponent's chips, 2 × B₁) — specifically, at least 2 × B₁ (capped at Second Bettor's total chips if all-in!).
  • Maximum bet: up to all of Second Bettor's chips.

Cup Reveal & Payout: The cup lifts to reveal Sun, Moon, or Star:
  • Correct guess: Paid 2:1 profit (receive 3× your wager back total; i.e., net +2× wager!).
  • Wrong guess: Lose your wagered chips to the house.

Bust Check: If either player drops to 0 chips, they are ELIMINATED immediately! If both hit 0 simultaneously, both restore to 1 chip for sudden death (or player with higher prior stack wins if round 10).
rules.hiddenVsPublicInfo: Public: Current round (1–10), both chip stacks, First Bettor's chosen symbol & bet size (visible to Second Bettor before locking!), and revealed past cups. Hidden: The symbol inside the cup and each player's private Guest Whisper clue.
rules.scoringAndPenalties: Win bet = net +2× bet (3× total return). Lose bet = -1× bet. Busting to 0 chips = instant elimination.
rules.winConditions: 1) Opponent busts to 0 chips, OR 2) Have strictly more chips after Round 10.
rules.tieBreakers: If chips are tied after Round 10, play Sudden-Death Overtime cups (11, 12...) until chip totals differ.
rules.seasonVariants: S2E2 included onlooker Garnet side-bets; S2E4 omitted onlooker side-bets. Exact 4-chip start, 2× forced response, and 2:1 profit payout preserved.

aiStrategy.easy: Follows its own whisper naively and bets 1–2 chips without considering forced-2× traps.
aiStrategy.genius: Exploits the forced-2× rule: when leading in chips as First Bettor, bets exactly floor(opp/2) to force the trailing rival all-in on uncertain cups; when Second Bettor, fuses its own whisper with the First Bettor's bet-size signal to infer the true symbol.
aiStrategy.grandFinal: Computes exact Bayesian posterior over {Sun, Moon, Star} from both its own whisper AND the opponent's bet/symbol choice (detecting bait-bets vs confident bets), optimizing survival-probability dynamic programming across remaining rounds.

rules.summaryEn: Scan a 3×3 grid of 9 geometric tiles (Shape × Shape Color × Background Color) to call 'Hap!' on 3-tile sets where each attribute is all-same or all-different (+1 pt), and shout 'Gyul!' when ZERO sets remain (+3 pts)!
rules.summaryZh: 在3×3共9张几何图块中（3种形状×3种图形色×3种背景色），轮流在10秒内寻找3个属性各自“全同或全异”的3张牌组合喊“合!”（+1分，错-1分）；当场上再无任何“合”时喊“结!”（+3分并结束本局，错-1分）。共10回合，总分高者胜。
rules.setup:
Deck of all 27 unique combinations of 3 attributes:
  • Shape: Circle, Square, Triangle
  • Shape Color: Red, Yellow, Blue
  • Background Color: Black, White, Gray
Game lasts 10 rounds. Each round deals 9 distinct cards in a numbered 3×3 grid (#1–#9). Starting player alternates each round (Round 1 by coin flip).
rules.components: 27 crisp vector geometric tiles (3×3×3); 3×3 numbered board (#1–#9); Found-Haps log tray; 10-second turn countdown ring; 'HAP!' and 'GYUL!' dramatic broadcast buttons.
turnStructure: 10-Second Turn Window: On your turn, you have 10 seconds to either call 'HAP!', call 'GYUL!', or PASS (letting timer expire passes with 0 penalty).

Calling 'HAP!': Select 3 distinct tile numbers (within 5 seconds after pressing HAP, or select 3 tiles directly). A triple is a valid HAP iff for EACH of the 3 attributes independently (Shape, Shape Color, Background), the 3 tiles are either ALL THE SAME or ALL DIFFERENT.
  • Valid & Not Yet Called: +1 point! The triple is recorded in the Found-Haps log. Plus, per official S4 rule, after scoring a Hap you get a 5-second bonus window to optionally call 'GYUL!' before turn passes!
  • Invalid or Duplicate or Timeout after calling HAP: -1 point, turn passes.

Calling 'GYUL!': Declare that NO unfound valid Haps remain on the 9-tile board.
  • Truly 0 unfound Haps left: +3 points! The round ends immediately.
  • At least 1 unfound Hap still exists: -1 point, turn passes.
5-Pass Safety Rule (S2E3+): If 5 consecutive turns pass with no valid Hap or Gyul scored, the round ends automatically (preventing infinite stalls).
rules.hiddenVsPublicInfo: 100% public information! Both players see the exact same 3×3 grid, all previously found Haps, and both scores.
rules.scoringAndPenalties: Valid Hap: +1 pt | Valid Gyul: +3 pts | Wrong Hap / Duplicate Hap / Wrong Gyul: -1 pt | Pass: 0 pts.
rules.winConditions: Highest cumulative score after 10 rounds.
rules.tieBreakers: If tied after Round 10, play Sudden-Death Tiebreaker Round 11 (repeating until score differs).
rules.seasonVariants: S1E12 Final had items ('Hap' count hint, 'Double' round). S2E3 added 5-pass auto-end. S4E8 added 5-second post-Hap Gyul bonus window (included in default rules!).

aiStrategy.easy: Scans slowly (5–8s), spots ~60% of valid Haps, occasionally mis-calls Gyul when 1 obscure Hap remains.
aiStrategy.genius: Computes all valid Haps internally but simulates human scan latency (3–5s), deliberately paces Haps to engineer parity so IT gets the final +3 Gyul turn!
aiStrategy.grandFinal: Calculates exact parity of remaining Haps (e.g., if 2 Haps remain, finds 1 and avoids blunder; knows when passing forces opponent into a bad parity), reacts fast (1.8–3.2s), and almost never misses a Gyul.

rules.summaryEn: Command mirrors, beam-splitters, and your corner laser cannon on an 8×8 board. Move or rotate 1 piece per turn, then automatically fire your laser—vaporize the enemy King to win!
rules.summaryZh: 在8×8棋盘上运用激光反射与分光原理消灭对方的“王”！双方各有10枚棋子（1激光炮、1分光器、1王、5三棱镜骑士、2四棱镜骑士）。每回合移动1格或旋转90°，随后己方激光自动发射，击中任何无镜面的一侧即摧毁棋子。
rules.setup:
8×8 grid with symmetrical mirrored starting formations (offer 2 classic Genius/Khet presets: 'Broadcast Classic' and 'Duel Fortress', plus optional symmetric start). Player 1 (Crimson) Laser sits fixed at corner (row 7, col 7); Player 2 (Cyan) Laser sits fixed at corner (row 0, col 0). Each player commands exactly 10 pieces:
  • 1 Laser Cannon (fixed in corner, indestructible, rotates 90° between the 2 inward orthogonal directions only—cannot move or point off-board)
  • 1 Splitter (45° half-silvered mirror: lets incoming beam pass STRAIGHT through AND simultaneously reflects a 90° copy! Indestructible; moves 1 square any direction or rotates 90°)
  • 1 King (moves 1 square in any of 8 directions; 0 mirrored sides—destroyed if hit by ANY laser beam from ANY side!)
  • 5 Triangle Knights (diagonal 45° mirror on hypotenuse reflecting laser 90°; hitting either of the 2 flat non-mirrored legs destroys the piece; moves 1 square any direction or rotates 90°)
  • 2 Square Knights (flat mirror on 1 face that reflects laser straight back 180° / blocks it; hitting any of the 3 non-mirrored sides destroys the piece; moves 1 square any direction or rotates 90°).
rules.components: 8×8 dark reflective grid; 20 metallic/crystal optical pieces (10 Crimson vs 10 Cyan); Dual-beam raytracer with bounce & split propagation (loop guard max 64 bounces).
turnStructure:
Choose ONE Action:
  • MOVE one of your movable pieces 1 square in any of the 8 directions (orthogonal or diagonal) into an empty square (cannot move Laser; cannot occupy opponent's Laser square).
  • ROTATE any one of your pieces (including your corner Laser, toggling between its 2 valid inward directions!) by 90° clockwise or counterclockwise.

Automatic Laser Fire: Immediately after your action, YOUR corner Laser fires a beam. Trace all beams (handling Splitter forks recursively):
  • Hits Triangle Knight mirrored hypotenuse → reflects 90°.
  • Hits Square Knight mirrored front → reflects 180° (blocks/absorbs without destroying).
  • Hits Splitter → splits into 1 straight beam + 1 90°-reflected beam (both continue!).
  • Hits any piece on an UNMIRRORED side (including friendly pieces or your OWN King!) → beam stops and that piece is DESTROYED and removed from the board!

Note: If a Splitter causes both Kings to be hit on the exact same laser firing, the player whose laser fired wins (or draw if self-kill only = instant loss!). Specifically: if YOUR King is hit and Opponent's King is NOT, you lose immediately!
rules.hiddenVsPublicInfo: 100% perfect-information abstract strategy game.
rules.scoringAndPenalties: Piece attrition narrows tactical defense; friendly fire is lethal.
rules.winConditions: Destroy the opponent's King with a laser beam (yours or theirs!).
rules.tieBreakers: Threefold board repetition or 50 consecutive turns with no piece captured = Draw (offer rematch).
rules.seasonVariants: Played exclusively in S2E5. (Note: Players on the show chose from preset formations; offering 2–3 curated balanced presets keeps every game fresh and faithful.)

aiStrategy.easy: 1-ply lookahead: avoids self-destructing its own King and takes immediate 1-move King kills or free captures.
aiStrategy.genius: 2-ply alpha-beta search with exact raycasting simulation: evaluates material (Triangle=3, Square=2, King safety shield), laser-lane proximity to enemy King, and Splitter fork threats.
aiStrategy.grandFinal: 3-ply alpha-beta search with move ordering (prioritizing beam-path pieces & King-adjacent rotates/moves), detecting 2-turn mirror-unblock checkmates and Splitter double-attacks.

rules.summaryEn: Command a 4-agent squad in pitch darkness! As Attacker, secretly choose which agents cross the red line for escalating combo points (1→2→3→4 pts). As Defender, press RED to eliminate crossers (only 3 uses!) or GREEN to hold fire—false Red alarms gift a free crossing!
rules.summaryZh: 双方各自率领4人小队互换攻守进行4回合“关灯越线”心理战！进攻方秘密决定派几名队员在暗黑中越过红线（同一队员第k次成功越线得k分）；防守方仅有3次按红钮抓捕机会（抓到即淘汰越线者，但空按红钮则罚送进攻方任选1人免费得分），绿钮不限次数。
rules.setup: Two halves (Half 1: P1 Attacks / P2 Defends; Half 2: P2 Attacks / P1 Defends). Each half consists of 4 Blackout Rounds. Attacking squad has 4 Operatives (A1–A4), each starting Alive with 0 prior crossings. Defending captain starts with 3 Red Button charges and unlimited Green Button presses.
rules.components: Pitch-black Studio Floor with glowing crimson Laser Boundary Line; 4 Operative badges per squad (showing Alive/Eliminated status & current crossing streak 0..4); iconic Red Alarm Button (3 charges) & Green Safe Button.
turnStructure:
Simultaneous Secret Decision (each of the 4 rounds in a half):
  • Attacker secretly selects ANY subset (0 to 4) of their ALIVE Operatives to cross the Red Line in the dark.
  • Defender (who cannot see who crossed, though subtle atmospheric footstep tension plays!) presses either the RED BUTTON (if charges > 0: 'Someone crossed!') or GREEN BUTTON ('Nobody crossed!').

Lights On — Reveal & Resolution:
  • GREEN BUTTON + Crossers ≥ 1: Every crossing Operative succeeds! Each crosser increments their personal crossing count c → c+1 and scores +c points for the team! (E.g., an Operative crossing 3 times scores 1 + 2 + 3 = 6 total points!)
  • GREEN BUTTON + 0 Crossers: Safe hold! 0 points scored, no eliminations.
  • RED BUTTON (consumes 1 of 3 charges) + Crossers ≥ 1: BUSTED! Every Operative who crossed this round is permanently ELIMINATED for the rest of the half (0 points scored).
  • RED BUTTON (consumes 1 of 3 charges) + 0 Crossers: FALSE ALARM PENALTY! The Attacker immediately chooses 1 of their Alive Operatives to receive a FREE safe crossing (advancing their count c → c+1 and scoring +c points!).
Half Swap: After 4 rounds (or if all 4 Attackers are eliminated), Half 1 score is locked and players swap Attacker/Defender roles for Half 2.
rules.hiddenVsPublicInfo: Public: Half & round number (1–4), each Operative's Alive/Eliminated status & prior successful crossings, remaining Red Button charges (0–3), and total scores. Hidden: Attacker's chosen crossing subset and Defender's Red/Green button choice until Lights On.
rules.scoringAndPenalties: Escalating triangular scoring per Operative: 1st cross = +1, 2nd = +2, 3rd = +3, 4th = +4 (max 10 pts per Operative!). Eliminated operatives cannot cross again.
rules.winConditions: Higher total points after both halves (4 Attack rounds + 4 Defend rounds each).
rules.tieBreakers: 1) More surviving Operatives at end of Attack half; 2) Sudden-death 1-round alternating Blackout shootout (1 Red charge) until score differs.
rules.seasonVariants: S2E4 Main Match was 5v5, 5 rounds, 4 Red Buttons. S2E6 Death Match was 4v4, 4 rounds, 3 Red Buttons (exact default used here!).

aiStrategy.easy: Sends 1–2 operatives randomly when attacking and presses Red whenever it has charges left.
aiStrategy.genius: Exploits the 3-Red / 4-Round pigeonhole math! As Attacker, sends 0 operatives on 1 key round to bait a Red False-Alarm Penalty, then floods high-streak operatives once Red charges drop low; as Defender, mixes Green on Round 1–2 to avoid predictable Red exhaustion before Round 4.
aiStrategy.grandFinal: Computes exact backward-induction game-tree Nash equilibria over state (round, redChargesLeft, aliveOperativeStreaks[]), knowing that with 0 Red charges left on Round 4 the Attacker gets a guaranteed full-squad sweep!

rules.summaryEn: Indian Poker meets Texas Hold'em! Combine your hidden forehead card with 2 face-up community cards to form Three-of-a-Kind > Straight (wrap-around 10-1 allowed!) > Pair > High Card—and NEVER fold a Straight or Triple (-10 chip penalty)!
rules.summaryZh: 印第安扑克与德州扑克的终极融合！40张牌（1–10各4张），每人额头1张暗牌+桌面2张公共牌，组成3张牌型：三条 > 顺子（10与1可相连！）> 对子 > 散牌。若握有顺子或三条弃牌，须额外罚给对手10枚筹码！
rules.setup: 40-card deck (4 copies each of numbers 1 through 10). Both players start with 30 chips (equal standard; S2 Finals used 20). Deck is NOT reshuffled until fewer than 4 cards remain.
rules.components: 40 number cards (1–10 × 4); 2 central Community Card pedestals; 30 Garnet Chips per player; Hand-Rank reference strip.
turnStructure: Ante & Deal: Both players post 1-chip ante. Dealer places 2 Community Cards FACE-UP in the center, and deals 1 Forehead Card to each player (visible to opponent, hidden from self).
Betting: Identical no-limit structure to Indian Poker (Check/Call, Raise up to effective stack, or Fold).

Hand Ranking (3 cards = Own Card + 2 Community Cards, highest to lowest):
  1. Three of a Kind (Triple): All 3 cards identical (e.g., 7-7-7). Higher number wins.
  2. Straight: 3 consecutive numbers. Wrap-around straights 9-10-1 and 10-1-2 are officially valid in The Genius! Canonical straight ranking from highest to lowest: 9-10-1 > 8-9-10 > 7-8-9 > 6-7-8 > 5-6-7 > 4-5-6 > 3-4-5 > 2-3-4 > 1-2-3 > 10-1-2.
  3. Pair: 2 cards with identical number. Compare the paired rank first; if both have the SAME paired rank (e.g. community pair), compare the 3rd kicker card (your own card).
  4. High Card: No combination. Compare highest card (since 2 cards are shared, this reduces to higher personal forehead card).
Fold Penalty: Folding while holding a Straight or Three of a Kind incurs an extra 10-chip penalty paid directly to the opponent! (Optional S2 Finals mode also penalizes folding a Pair by 5 chips.)
Draw Carryover: If both hands have exact equal rank (e.g., identical personal cards), pot carries over to the next hand.
rules.hiddenVsPublicInfo: Public: Both community cards, opponent's forehead card, pot, stacks, and all previously revealed cards in the 40-card shoe. Hidden: Your own forehead card.
rules.scoringAndPenalties: Showdown winner takes pot. Folding Straight/Triple = -10 chips penalty to opponent.
rules.winConditions: Reduce opponent's chips to 0.
rules.tieBreakers: Effective stack cap prevents simultaneous bust; pot carries over on tie hands.
rules.seasonVariants: S2E7: 1 Garnet = 5 chips. S2E10: 1 Garnet = 2 chips. S2E12 Final: 20 chips, -5 Pair fold penalty, +Swap Community Cards item. Default web mode: 30 chips, -10 Straight/Triple penalty.

aiStrategy.easy: Only checks whether opponent currently makes a Pair/Straight/Triple with the board and bets linearly.
aiStrategy.genius: Computes exact probability distribution of its own hidden card across remaining 40-card shoe to get exact Win/Tie/Loss equity AND P(own hand is Straight/Triple) before deciding whether folding is -EV due to the 10-chip penalty.
aiStrategy.grandFinal: Combines exact shoe-conditional equity with board-texture exploitation: aggressively value-bets when community cards are paired/connected and opponent misses, and bluffs big when opponent holds a weak high card on a scary connected board (e.g. 5-6).

rules.summaryZh: 双方各有0–8共9张数字砖（偶数0,2,4,6,8为黑，奇数1,3,5,7为白）。每轮由上轮胜者先出，数字全程保密仅公开黑白颜色与当轮胜负！利用黑白线索推理对手残牌，9轮后胜分高者胜（先得5分即锁定胜局）。
rules.setup: Each player receives 9 tiles: 5 BLACK tiles (0, 2, 4, 6, 8) and 4 WHITE tiles (1, 3, 5, 7). Round 1 First Player is decided by coin flip (or higher Garnets on TV).
rules.components: 9 tactile Obsidian Black (0,2,4,6,8) and Marble White (1,3,5,7) tiles per player; Central Dealer Judge Chamber; Round-by-Round Color/Winner History strip.
turnStructure: First Player Plays: The round's First Player chooses 1 unused tile and places it FACE-DOWN. The opponent sees ONLY whether the tile is BLACK (even: 0,2,4,6,8) or WHITE (odd: 1,3,5,7)—NOT the number!
Second Player Responds: Seeing the color of the First Player's tile, the Second Player selects 1 unused tile face-down (its Black/White color is also visible).

Hidden Comparison: The system (Dealer) compares the two numbers secretly:
  • Strictly higher number wins +1 Win Point.
  • Equal numbers = Draw (0 points to either player).
  • CRITICAL RULE: Neither player EVER learns the exact number their opponent played—only the color (Black/White) and the outcome (Win/Loss/Draw)!
Next Turn Order: The winner of the round becomes First Player for the next round. If the round was a Draw, First Player stays the same as the previous round.
Early Victory: As soon as one player reaches 5 Win Points (or mathematically cannot be caught), or after all 9 rounds conclude, the match ends.
rules.hiddenVsPublicInfo: Public: Each player's remaining Black/White tile counts (e.g., '3 Black, 2 White left'), the color of the currently played tile, and the complete round history of (P1 Color, P2 Color, Winner). Hidden: Exact numbers played and exact numbers remaining in opponent's hand.
rules.scoringAndPenalties: +1 Win Point per round won; 0 for tie or loss. Used tiles are permanently discarded.
rules.winConditions: More Win Points after 9 rounds (or first to reach an insurmountable lead, e.g. 5 points).
rules.tieBreakers: Exact tie after 9 rounds (e.g., 4–4 with 1 draw) = Rematch (instant 'Tie! Play Decider Match' button).
rules.seasonVariants: Identical rules across S2E9, S2E11, and S4E1 (S4E1 used coin flip for Round 1 first player).

aiStrategy.easy: Plays mid-high tiles early and dumps 0 occasionally against random tiles.
aiStrategy.genius: Maintains a live Bayesian belief table over opponent's remaining exact tiles consistent with all prior (myNumber, oppColor, outcome) constraints; uses Second-Player advantage to sacrifice 0 against strong White/Black leads and snipe +1 wins.
aiStrategy.grandFinal: Runs exact constraint-filtering over permutations of opponent's remaining Black/White sets (at most 5!×4! = 2,880 total histories, trivial to track exactly!) and optimizes expected round-win differential, intentionally throwing White 1 or Black 0 to steal second-player reactivity.

rules.summaryZh: 双方各有99点能量，分9回合盲注对决！投入点数保密，但对手可见两大线索：①单数(0–9)亮黑牌、双位数(10+)亮白牌；②5格剩余能量灯（每跌破80/60/40/20/0即熄灭1格，且在确认出价瞬间立即变化）。先得5胜或9轮胜多者胜！
rules.setup: Each player starts with exactly 99 points and 5 illuminated Energy Lamps. Round 1 First Player is decided by coin flip.
rules.components: 99-point digital bid dial (0–99); Black (<10) / White (≥10) bid indicator plaque; 5-Lamp Energy Gauge per player where lit lamps = (remaining === 0 ? 0 : Math.min(5, Math.floor(remaining / 20) + 1)) — specifically: 80–99 pts = 5 lamps, 60–79 pts = 4 lamps, 40–59 pts = 3 lamps, 20–39 pts = 2 lamps, 1–19 pts = 1 lamp, 0 pts = 0 lamps (dropping below 80/60/40/20/1 extinguishes a lamp instantly upon bid lock).
turnStructure:
First Player Bids: The First Player secretly enters any integer bid b₁ ∈ [0, remainingPoints] and locks it in.
  • IMMEDIATELY upon lock-in, the opponent sees TWO clues:
    1. Color Plaque: BLACK if b₁ ≤ 9 (single digit), WHITE if b₁ ≥ 10 (two digits).
    2. Live Gauge Update: First Player's 5-lamp bar updates instantly to reflect their NEW remaining bracket (80–99 / 60–79 / 40–59 / 20–39 / 1–19 / 0)!

Second Player Responds: Using the Color Plaque + Lamp Drop count (e.g., if 2 lamps just turned off, opponent spent at least 21–59 points!), Second Player enters b₂ ∈ [0, remainingPoints] and locks it in (updating their own Color & Lamps too).

Hidden Comparison: Both bids are permanently deducted from each player's 99-point pool. Dealer reveals ONLY who won:
  • Higher bid = +1 Win Point (becomes First Player next round).
  • Equal bids = Draw (0 points; First Player stays unchanged).
  • Exact bid values are NEVER revealed!
Match End: Ends immediately if a player reaches 5 Win Points (or cannot be caught), or after Round 9.
rules.hiddenVsPublicInfo: Public: Both players' current 5-lamp Energy Gauges, round history of (P1 Color + Lamp Change, P2 Color + Lamp Change, Winner), and Win Point scores. Hidden: Exact point pool remaining and exact bid numbers.
rules.scoringAndPenalties: Points spent are gone forever; leftover points at the end of Round 9 have zero value.
rules.winConditions: More Win Points after 9 rounds (or first to insurmountable lead, e.g. 5 wins).
rules.tieBreakers: Equal Win Points after Round 9 = Draw & instant Rematch.
rules.seasonVariants: Consistent rules in S3E1 and S3E3.

aiStrategy.easy: Bids ~11 points on most rounds with occasional random 0-point dumps.
aiStrategy.genius: Tracks exact [minRemaining, maxRemaining] interval of the opponent using lamp drop boundaries AND prior win/loss inequalities; dumps 0 whenever opponent drops 2 lamps, and bids just enough (10–13 or 19–22) to steal Black or single-lamp White leads.
aiStrategy.grandFinal: Performs exact interval arithmetic on opponent's remaining points + solves dynamic budget-allocation (aiming to win 5 rounds with ~18–21 pts each while throwing 0 on 4 rounds, and intentionally timing bids right above 80/60/40/20 thresholds to disguise bid size!).

rules.summaryZh: 双方仅持1枚筹码开局，共11回合（8名观战嘉宾+3名手势全公开的虚拟玩家）。每回合先手决定亲自猜拳（赢可得1/2/3/4枚递增筹码）或押注对手胜负（押胜/负中赔2倍、平局退回；押平局中赔3倍！）。11轮后筹码多者胜！
rules.setup: 11-round schedule (S4E3 official format): 8 Hidden-Sign AI Guests + 3 Public Virtual Players (inserted at Rounds 3, 7, and 10, showing known Rock, Paper, and Scissors respectively!). Both candidates start with 1 chip. First-choice player alternates every round (Round 1 by coin flip).

turnStructure:
Role Selection: Round's First Player inspects the round's Guest (or Public Virtual Player) and chooses either:
  • DUEL (play RPS against the guest), OR
  • BET (let the opponent duel while you bet on their outcome).
  The other player automatically gets the remaining role.

Duelist's Lock: The Duelist secretly chooses Rock, Paper, or Scissors (played face-down before the Bettor bets!). Note: On Public Virtual Player rounds, the Duelist KNOWS the VP's hand—so they can INTENTIONALLY lose or draw to wreck the Bettor's wager!
Bettor's Wager: The Bettor chooses a prediction (WIN, LOSE, or DRAW for the Duelist) and wagers 1..all of their chips (if the Bettor has 0 chips, they bet 0 and skip betting).

Reveal & Payout:
  • Duelist Payout: If Duelist WINS the RPS match, Duelist earns +R chips from the bank (R = 1 in R1–3, 2 in R4–6, 3 in R7–9, 4 in R10–11). On Draw or Loss, Duelist earns 0 (loses nothing).
  • Bettor Payout:
    - Bet on WIN or LOSE: Correct = receive 2× wager (net +1× wager); Wrong = lose wager; If RPS ends in DRAW = wager is refunded untouched!
    - Bet on DRAW: Correct = receive 3× wager (net +2× wager); Wrong = lose wager.
Match End: After 11 rounds, higher chip count wins.
rules.hiddenVsPublicInfo: Public: Round number, reward tier, both chip stacks, Public Virtual Players' exact signs, and AI Guests' archetype/reputation hints. Hidden: AI Guests' locked signs, private guest whisper tells, Duelist's locked RPS sign until Bettor locks.
rules.scoringAndPenalties: You can never go negative; 0 chips still lets you earn chips by Dueling on future rounds!
rules.winConditions: More chips after Round 11.
rules.tieBreakers: S4 Official Overtime: 2-round sudden-death extension against Public Virtual Players (each player gets First Choice once); if still tied, repeat until broken.

aiStrategy.genius: Understands the iconic Genius twist on Public Virtual Player rounds: if leading or facing a huge opponent bet, intentionally throws a LOSS or DRAW to wipe out the opponent's bankroll instead of greedily taking +2/+3 chips!
aiStrategy.grandFinal: Solves the 3×3 mixed-strategy matrix on Public Virtual Player rounds (balancing Duelist Win/Lose/Draw vs Bettor Win/Lose/Draw based on exact chip differential and remaining rounds) and sizes bets exponentially late when trailing.

rules.summaryZh: 每张双面牌正面公开、背面仅本人可见（第4季规则：正反面必为一奇一偶，1–10）。开局各40枚筹码，下注前锁定押正面或押背面（不可更改），或发动“双面下注”（需下对手2倍筹码）：若己方正反两面均大于对手所选面则大获全胜并额外抢走对手10枚筹码！
rules.setup: S4 Grand Final Official Deck: 200 double-sided cards (4 sets of 50 pairs where one side is odd {1,3,5,7,9} and the other side is even {2,4,6,8,10}). Both players start with 40 chips (S3 variant: 90 cards with any distinct 1–10 pair, 30 chips). First player alternates/winner leads.
rules.components: 200 3D-flippable double-sided Obsidian/Gold cards; Dual Front/Back betting zones per player; Double-Bet override switch; 40 Garnet Chips per player.
turnStructure: Ante & Deal: Both players post 1-chip ante. Each player is dealt 1 double-sided card: FRONT side is publicly visible to both players; BACK side is secretly peekable ONLY by its owner! (Because of Odd/Even pairing, knowing opponent's Front parity narrows their Back to 5 possible numbers!)

Side Lock & Betting: On a player's FIRST betting action of the hand, they lock whether they are playing their FRONT or BACK side (displayed publicly as a glowing chip marker on their Front or Back zone—cannot switch sides afterward, except upgrading to Double-Bet!). Standard no-limit betting proceeds (Bet/Raise, Call, Fold).

DOUBLE-BET (양면베팅): At any point during betting (if you have enough chips to match 2× opponent's current bet), you may declare a DOUBLE-BET! You place equal matching bets on BOTH your Front and Back zones (2× total stake; betting continues or concludes if opponent calls/folds).
  • To WIN a Double-Bet showdown: BOTH your Front AND your Back numbers must be STRICTLY GREATER than your opponent's single chosen side! (If either side is ≤ opponent's chosen side, you LOSE the entire pot!)
  • Double-Bet Bonus: If the Double-Bettor WINS the showdown—OR if the opponent FOLDS against a Double-Bet!—the Double-Bettor steals an EXTRA +10 bonus chips directly from the opponent! (If the Double-Bettor loses, they pay NO extra 10-chip penalty—only the chips in the pot!)
Showdown & Draw: When a bet is called, chosen sides are revealed and compared. Higher number wins the pot. On a tie (single-side showdown only), the pot carries over to the next hand.
rules.hiddenVsPublicInfo: Public: Both players' Front numbers, which zone (Front / Back / Double-Bet) each player has locked their bet onto, pot, and chip stacks. Hidden: Your Back number (until showdown if Back or Double-Bet was played).
rules.scoringAndPenalties: Standard pot win + massive +10 bonus chip steal on successful Double-Bet (including when opponent folds to a Double-Bet!).
rules.winConditions: Reduce opponent's chip stack to 0.
rules.tieBreakers: Effective stack caps prevent simultaneous bust; tied showdowns carry pot over.
rules.seasonVariants: S3E4/E5: 90 cards (all distinct 1–10 pairs), 30 chips. S4E10: 200 cards (Odd/Even paired), 40 chips (recommended default for deeper parity deduction!).

aiStrategy.easy: Always plays whichever side is higher on its own card, rarely Double-Bets unless holding 9/10.
aiStrategy.genius: Uses the S4 Odd/Even rule (e.g., if opponent shows Front 9 and bets Back, opponent's Back MUST be even {2,4,6,8,10}!), intentionally plays a weaker Front to conceal a strong Back or bluff-triggers Double-Bet when opponent's Front is weak (≤5) to harvest +10 fold equity!
aiStrategy.grandFinal: Computes exact Bayesian range over opponent's locked side (Front vs Back parity distribution), balances thin Front value-bets, semi-bluff Double-Bets when holding e.g. (8, 7) against a scared opponent, and defends rationally against opponent Double-Bets knowing the +10 fold tax makes calling much wider mathematically optimal!

rules.summaryEn: Deceptively deep micro-chess on a 3×4 board! Capture enemy pieces to drop them back as your own soldiers, promote your Pawn (子) into a Feudal Lord (侯), and win by capturing the enemy King (王) OR surviving 1 full turn with your King inside enemy territory!
rules.summaryZh: 改编自《动物将棋》的3×4极致策略棋！每方4枚棋子（王、将、相、子），吃掉敌子可俘虏并在己方回合空降重用（不可空降到敌方底线3格）。“子”冲入敌阵升变为“侯”。吃掉敌王或己方王闯入敌阵并挺过对手1回合即获胜！三局两胜制。
rules.setup:
3 columns × 4 rows (12 squares). Each player's back rank (closest 3 squares) is their Territory (highlighted Crimson for P1, Gold/Green for P2). Initial symmetrical placement (from each player's perspective facing forward):
  • Back-Left: Sang / Minister (相) — moves 1 square DIAGONALLY (4 directions).
  • Back-Center: Wang / King (王) — moves 1 square in ALL 8 directions.
  • Back-Right: Jang / General (將) — moves 1 square ORTHOGONALLY (front, back, left, right).
  • Front-Center (in front of King): Ja / Man (子) — moves 1 square STRAIGHT FORWARD only.
Match format: Best-of-3 games (first to win 2 games wins the Death Match). First mover alternates each game.
rules.components: 3×4 carved wood-and-obsidian 12-square board; 8 directional wooden tiles with glowing movement dots on edges/corners (王, 將, 相, 子/侯); Prisoner Capture Docks; 30-second turn timer (configurable).
turnStructure:
On your turn (within turn clock), perform ONE action:
  • MOVE one of your pieces on the board 1 square along one of its marked directional dots (onto an empty square or capturing an enemy piece).
  • DROP one of your captured prisoner pieces from your dock onto any EMPTY square—EXCEPT you may NEVER drop a piece into the opponent's 3-square Territory (the opponent's back rank)!

Promotion & Demotion:
  • When your Ja (子) moves into the opponent's 3-square Territory, it immediately flips and promotes into a Hu / Feudal Lord (侯), which can move 1 square in 6 directions (all directions EXCEPT the 2 backward diagonals—same as a Shogi Gold General!).
  • If a promoted Hu (侯) is captured, it reverts back to an unpromoted Ja (子) in the capturer's prisoner dock.

Try Rule (Territory Infiltration Win): If your King (王) moves into the opponent's 3-square Territory AND survives the opponent's immediate reply turn without being captured, you WIN immediately at the start of your next turn!
Note: Pieces CANNOT rotate in place; captured pieces do not have to be dropped immediately.
rules.hiddenVsPublicInfo: 100% perfect-information deterministic strategy game.
rules.scoringAndPenalties: Running out of turn clock (if timer enabled) forfeits the game.
rules.winConditions: Win a single game by: 1) Capturing opponent's King (王), 2) Your King enters enemy Territory and survives 1 turn (Try Rule), or 3) Opponent times out. Win the Death Match by winning 2 games (Best-of-3).
rules.tieBreakers: Threefold exact state repetition (board + hands + turn) = Game Draw (replay that game).
rules.seasonVariants: S3E7: single/best-of-3 untimed; S3E12 Final: 90s clock; S4E11: Best-of-3 with 30s turn clock (default Best-of-3 with toggleable 30s / Unlimited timer).

aiStrategy.grandFinal: Depth-7+ iterative-deepening negamax with alpha-beta pruning, killer moves, and endgame Try-Rule / forced-mate solver (Twelve Janggi has a small branching factor ~10–15, so Depth 7–8 runs in <250ms in pure JS and plays at terrifying Genius-pro level!).

rules.summaryZh: 在暗藏32堵隐形墙的7×7棋盘上竞速抵达对角终点！每回合可上下左右移动3步（每人全场拥有2次“双倍机会”可连走6步）。一旦撞上隐形墙立即响起警报并退回起点重来，考验空间记忆与路线规划！
rules.setup:
7×7 grid (49 squares) with 84 internal cell-to-cell edges, of which exactly 32 are INVISIBLE WALLS (procedurally generated with guaranteed solvability and IDENTICAL shortest-path distance—typically 14–18 steps—for both players).
  • Player 1 starts at bottom-left (6,0) → Goal at top-right (0,6); Player 2 starts at bottom-right (6,6) → Goal at top-left (0,0), so both runners start on adjacent corners and race diagonally across shared maze territory for maximum mutual wall-discovery tension!
  • Both players start with 2 'Double Chance' tokens.
rules.components: 7×7 obsidian-and-slate illuminated floor grid; 32 hidden wall segments (briefly flash crimson on collision, NEVER permanently shown—true memory test!); 2 runner avatars; 2 Double-Chance boosters per player.
turnStructure: Action Choice: At the start of your turn, optionally activate 1 'Double Chance' (2 uses total per match) to boost your movement budget from 3 steps to 6 steps for this turn.

Step-by-Step Movement: Click adjacent orthogonal squares (Up/Down/Left/Right—NO diagonals!) one step at a time, up to your step budget (3 or 6). You MAY stop early if you want, or must use steps up to 3/6 (on the show, players move up to 3 or 6 steps; allowing 1..3 / 1..6 or exact step-by-step until wall hit or stop is crisp!).

Wall Collision: If you attempt to cross an edge containing one of the 32 invisible walls:
  • SIREN ALARM triggers! That specific edge flashes glowing crimson for 1.5 seconds so BOTH players see where the wall is, then fades back to invisible!
  • Your turn ENDS immediately and your avatar is teleported all the way back to your Start square!
Safe Completion: If you complete your steps without hitting a wall, your avatar stays on that square and the turn passes to your opponent.
Victory: Reaching your Goal square wins IMMEDIATELY!
rules.hiddenVsPublicInfo: Public: Both avatars' current positions, step paths walked (every safe edge crossed is implicitly proven wall-free!), temporary siren flash on wall hit, and remaining Double Chances. Hidden: All 32 walls (players must remember them mentally!).
rules.scoringAndPenalties: Hitting a hidden wall resets your position to Start and forfeits remaining steps this turn.
rules.winConditions: First player to step onto their Goal square wins immediately.
rules.tieBreakers: No ties possible.
rules.seasonVariants: Consistent rules in S3E8 and S3E9 (7×7 grid, 32 walls, 3 steps/turn, 2 Double Chances of 6 steps).

aiStrategy.easy: Remembers ~55% of discovered walls/safe edges and explores greedily toward goal.
aiStrategy.genius: Remembers ~88% of discovered walls and runs BFS shortest-path planning over known-safe + unexplored edges; saves Double Chances for confirmed safe highway sprints.
aiStrategy.grandFinal: Near-perfect wall memory, uses A* shortest-path search preferring proven-safe corridors learned from BOTH players' movements, and times its two 6-step Double Chances to leap 12 steps in 2 turns straight into the Goal!

rules.summaryEn: Lay 1 to 3 double-sided track tiles (Straight / 90° Curve) per turn to build a single closed monorail loop connecting both sides of the Station. Place the final closing tile to win—OR declare 'IMPOSSIBLE!' to force your rival to prove a loop still exists!
rules.summaryZh: 改编自桌游《威尼斯连线》：起始放置2块相邻车站砖，轮流使用16块双面铁轨砖（正面直线、背面90°弯道），每回合须沿同一直线连续放置1–3块（至少1块紧邻已有砖块）。放完最后一块使全部已放砖块连成单一闭合环路者胜；或在己方回合宣告“不可能”，逼对手用剩余砖块拼出闭合环路，对手拼不出即宣告者胜！
rules.setup: 2 adjacent horizontal Station tiles (with straight tracks running horizontally through both, exposing 1 open track end on the left and 1 open track end on the right) are placed at the center of an unbounded square grid. Shared supply of 16 double-sided Track Tiles (Front = Straight track, Back = 90° Curve track; rotatable to any of 4 orientations).
rules.components: Infinite scrollable/auto-centering square grid; 2 glowing Station tiles; Shared pool of 16 brass-and-neon double-sided Track Tiles; 'Flip (Straight/Curve)', 'Rotate 90°', 'Commit Turn (1–3 tiles)', and dramatic 'DECLARE IMPOSSIBLE!' controls.
turnStructure:
On your turn, choose ONE of two actions:
  A) PLACE 1, 2, or 3 tiles from the remaining supply (must place at least 1, at most min(3, remainingTiles)):
     • Each placed tile may be Straight or 90° Curve in any orientation.
     • At least ONE newly placed tile must be orthogonally adjacent (Up/Down/Left/Right) to a previously existing tile on the board.
     • If placing 2 or 3 tiles in one turn, ALL newly placed tiles must lie in a SINGLE STRAIGHT ROW OR COLUMN (collinear) and be contiguous/adjacent along that line (note: per official Venice Connection / Genius rules, they must be lined up side-by-side in a straight line!).
     • Tiles do NOT need to connect track-to-track immediately—however, ALL placed tiles on the board must eventually become part of the single closed loop (no stray unused dead tiles!).
  B) DECLARE 'IMPOSSIBLE!' (instead of placing tiles): Assert that NO valid single closed loop using ALL currently placed tiles (plus any subset of the remaining supply tiles) can possibly be completed!

Closed Loop Victory: If immediately after your placement, EVERY tile on the board (both Stations + ALL placed track tiles, with zero stray/disconnected tiles and zero dangling open ends) forms ONE single continuous closed loop passing through the Station, YOU WIN IMMEDIATELY! (You do NOT need to use all 16 tiles!)

Resolving 'IMPOSSIBLE!': The opponent immediately enters Proof Mode and gets an unlimited single turn to place remaining tiles from the supply (ignoring the 1–3 limit) to complete a valid single closed loop incorporating ALL placed tiles:
  • If the opponent succeeds → Opponent WINS!
  • If the opponent gives up or fails (or mathematically no solution exists) → The player who declared 'IMPOSSIBLE!' WINS!

Supply Exhausted without Loop: If the 16th tile is placed without forming a valid single closed loop, the player who placed it loses (or opponent wins immediately because loop is impossible with 0 tiles left!).
rules.hiddenVsPublicInfo: 100% perfect-information combinatorial board game.
rules.scoringAndPenalties: Every placed tile MUST be used in the final single loop; creating a branch/collision or trapping an open end against a non-connecting tile immediately makes a loop impossible!
rules.winConditions: 1) Place the tile(s) that complete a single closed loop using all placed tiles, OR 2) Correctly declare 'IMPOSSIBLE!' when the opponent cannot complete a valid loop with remaining tiles.
rules.tieBreakers: No ties possible.
rules.seasonVariants: Identical rules in S3E10 and S4E6.

aiStrategy.easy: Extends the open track ends cleanly 1–2 tiles at a time, checks for 1-turn loop completions, and declares Impossible when an obvious dead-end collision occurs.
aiStrategy.genius: Runs a fast exact backtracking loop-feasibility solver (checking parity: in any closed loop on a square grid, total tiles MUST be EVEN, turns must be even ≥4, and open-end Manhattan distance must be ≤ remaining tiles!) to detect IMPOSSIBLE boards with 100% accuracy and force opponent into bad parity.
aiStrategy.grandFinal: Combines exact loop-solvability search with Nim-like combinatorial parity control (aiming to leave 4 or 8 tiles needed to close so opponent cannot finish in 1–3 tiles, OR setting subtle 2-tile-short parity traps and immediately hitting 'DECLARE IMPOSSIBLE!' the moment the opponent makes a geometrically fatal placement!).

rules.summaryEn: Behind a privacy screen, lock the exact play order of your 10 tiles (0–9: Even=Black, Odd=White) AND split 30 chips across all 10 slots (min 1 per slot). Drop the screen! Each round, the lower bettor must either FOLD or CALL by borrowing chips from future slots or winnings!
rules.summaryZh: 《黑与白》终极进化版！双方各有0–9共10张砖（偶黑奇白）与30枚筹码。开局先在屏风后秘密排定10回合出牌顺序并把30枚筹码全部分配到10张砖下（每张至少1枚）。撤掉屏风后逐轮亮出筹码与黑白颜色：筹码少的一方选择跟注（须从已赢筹码或后续牌堆借调补齐，后续每格仍须留至少1枚）或弃牌（不亮数字直接输掉己方筹码）。10轮后筹码多者胜！
rules.setup: Each player has 10 numbered tiles: 5 BLACK (0, 2, 4, 6, 8) and 5 WHITE (1, 3, 5, 7, 9), plus 30 chips.
rules.components: 10-slot Obsidian/Ivory Schedule Board per player (showing Color Black/White publicly once partition drops, hiding the exact numeral); 30 Garnet Chips allocated across slots + Won-Chips Reserve bank.
turnStructure:
Phase 1 — Secret Pre-Commitment (Behind Partition): Both players secretly:
  1. Arrange all 10 tiles (0–9) into Slots #1 through #10.
  2. Distribute ALL 30 chips across Slots #1 through #10, placing at least 1 chip on every single slot (sum = 30).

Phase 2 — Partition Drop: The privacy screen lifts! BOTH players now see ALL 10 slots' tile COLORS (Black or White) and ALL 10 slots' pre-committed CHIP STACKS for the entire 10-round match—while all 10 numerals remain hidden!

Phase 3 — 10 Sequential Clashes (Slot #1 → Slot #10):
  • If BOTH players have EQUAL chips on Slot #k: Immediate Showdown! Both numerals are flipped PUBLICLY! Higher numeral wins BOTH stacks (moved into Winner's Reserve bank). If numerals are EQUAL (Draw), each player takes back their own chips into their Reserve bank (or split pot).
  • If ONE player has FEWER chips on Slot #k (betA < betB): The LOWER-BET player chooses:
    1. FOLD: Immediately surrender their Slot #k chips to the higher bettor (higher bettor takes both stacks into Reserve). NEITHER tile's numeral is revealed!
    2. CALL: Match the higher bettor's exact chip amount by pulling the difference (betB - betA) from:
       - Your Reserve bank (chips already won in earlier rounds), AND/OR
       - Your FUTURE Slots (#k+1 .. #10), provided EVERY future slot keeps at least 1 chip!
       (If your Reserve + borrowable future surplus < betB - betA, you cannot Call and must Fold!)
       Once called, BOTH numerals flip PUBLICLY and higher numeral wins the entire matched pot!
rules.hiddenVsPublicInfo: Public (after Setup): All 10 slot colors (Black/White), all 10 slot chip counts, Reserve chip banks, and numerals revealed on Showdowns. Hidden: Numerals of unplayed slots AND numerals of Folded rounds!
rules.scoringAndPenalties: Total chips at end of Round 10 = Reserve Bank (all unused future slots are resolved by Round 10).
rules.winConditions: More total chips after all 10 rounds conclude.
rules.tieBreakers: 1) More showdown round wins; 2) Sudden-death 3-slot mini-match (tiles 1,2,3 + 6 chips).
rules.seasonVariants: Played in S3E11 (and scheduled for S4E12). Notice the 10-tile deck (0–9, adding White 9!) compared to Black and White I's 9 tiles (0–8).

aiStrategy.easy: Puts big chips on 7, 8, 9 and 1 chip on low tiles; calls whenever its own number is ≥6.
aiStrategy.genius: Mixes bluff-heavy stacks (e.g., putting 5–6 chips on Black 0 or White 1 to force opponent folds) with under-bet traps (putting 1–2 chips on White 9 or Black 8 intending to CALL & borrow against opponent's 6-chip stacks!).
aiStrategy.grandFinal: Solves exact Bayesian likelihood of opponent's numeral given (slotColor, slotChips, alreadyRevealedNumerals), strategically borrows from future weak slots when calling with an 8/9 trap, and folds marginal mid-cards against high-conviction enemy stacks to preserve borrowing liquidity for late rounds.

rules.summaryEn: You get just 5 SECONDS to memorize a 4×4 wall (A–P) hiding numbers 1–12 and 4 operators! When a Target Number drops, slam the buzzer and pick 3 letters (Number → Operator → Number) within 5 seconds to hit the exact target. First to 10 points wins!
rules.summaryZh: A–P共16块翻板背面藏有数字1–12与4个运算符号（第4季版为 +, ×, ÷, √x+√y），开局全盘仅展示5秒！每轮随机抽出目标自然数，先按抢答器者在5秒内按“数字→符号→数字”顺序点出3个字母拼出目标值即得1分（用√x+√y得2分！），超时或答错则机会不限时转交对手，每轮结束后依序重显1块板3秒。先达10分胜！
rules.setup:
4×4 board labeled A–P hiding 16 shuffled tiles: integers 1 through 12 (12 tiles) + 4 operators:
  • S4E4 Official Mode (Default): `+`, `×`, `÷`, and `√x+√y` (where x and y are distinct perfect squares from {1, 4, 9}, yielding √1+√4=3, √1+√9=4, √4+√9=5 for +2 bonus points!).
  • S3E12 Classic Toggle: `+`, `-`, `×`, `÷`.
At match start, ALL 16 tiles flip open simultaneously for exactly 5.0 seconds, then flip closed to A–P!
rules.components: 4×4 illuminated A–P flip wall; Lotto Target Number Sphere; Giant Broadcast Buzzer button; 5-second answer countdown bar; Formula Preview slot `[ ? ] [ op ] [ ? ] = Target`; Scoreboard to 10.
turnStructure: Initial 5-Second Flash: All 16 tiles reveal for 5 seconds, then close.
Target Drop: System draws a unique Target Natural Number (guaranteed solvable by at least one valid 3-tile expression on the board, never repeated).

Buzzer Race: First player to hit the BUZZER gets 5.0 seconds to click 3 distinct letters in strict order: `[First Number Tile] → [Operator Tile] → [Second Number Tile]`.
  • All 3 chosen tiles flip open publicly (even if wrong!) for 2.5 seconds so BOTH players gain free memory refreshes—UNLESS the buzzer player timed out without clicking all 3 tiles (in which case 0 tiles flip!).

Verification:
  • Valid Expression (exact integer equality, distinct tiles, proper Number-Op-Number types): Scores +1 point (or +2 points if using `√x+√y` in S4 mode!) and ends the round!
  • Wrong Expression or 5-Second Timeout: The turn passes immediately to the OPPONENT with NO time limit (opponent must still submit a valid 3-tile expression or pass back; alternating until someone solves the target!).
Progressive Memory Refresh (S4E4 rule): Between rounds, 1 tile on the board (cycling A → B → C → ... → P) flips open for 3 seconds for both players before the next Target drops!
rules.hiddenVsPublicInfo: 100% symmetric shared memory! Every flash, wrong-answer flip, and between-round tile reveal is visible to both players.
rules.scoringAndPenalties: +1 pt per solved target (+2 pts with √x+√y in S4 mode). Wrong answer gives opponent a free untimed shot + reveals 3 tiles.
rules.winConditions: First player to reach 10 points wins immediately.
rules.tieBreakers: No ties possible (only one player scores per round).
rules.seasonVariants: S3E12 Final: +, -, ×, ÷ (all +1 pt). S4E4 Death Match: +, ×, ÷, √x+√y (+2 pts for √x+√y, + progressive 3s tile reveal between rounds). Default = S4E4 with S3E12 Classic toggle!

aiStrategy.easy: Memorizes ~6 tiles initially, buzzes slowly (4–7s), and sometimes flips wrong adjacent letters.
aiStrategy.genius: Memorizes ~11–12 tiles initially and absorbs every flipped tile during the match; buzzes in 2.2–4.0s whenever it knows a valid 3-tile combo, and prioritizes +2 √x+√y when Target ∈ {3, 4, 5}.
aiStrategy.grandFinal: Memorizes 14–15 tiles on the 5s flash, absorbs 100% of subsequent flips, computes all valid equations for the Target instantly, and buzzes in 1.2–2.2s with surgical accuracy (taking calculated guesses when only 1 tile of a 3-tile equation is unknown!).

finalExclusiveGames.rulesSummary: Both finalists set a secret 4-digit passcode (0–9, repeats allowed). Players take turns asking structured logic questions about the rival's code—and the defender MUST answer with a LIE! Accidentally telling the truth triggers the Truth Detector alarm and forces the defender to reveal one digit NOT in their code. First to crack the exact 4-digit code wins.

finalExclusiveGames.rulesSummary: 6×9 board with 18 minus-sign borders; each player secretly arranges 14 hidden pieces (numbers 1–10, 3 Mines, 1 King) in their 3×6 home territory. Orthogonal adjacency triggers combat: if Sum ≥ 10 higher number wins; if Sum < 10 LOWER number wins! Across a Minus border, compare difference instead. Mines self-destruct both pieces. Win by capturing the enemy King, eliminating all non-King pieces, or marching your King to the enemy back rank.

finalExclusiveGames.rulesSummary: 11 rounds of black-box math induction: a mystery binary operator `A ★ B = ?` is shown. Highest score after 11 rounds wins.
